title: Common Ground Deliberative Dialogues; Hot Button Topics in Society
department: Counseling, Higher Education, and Special Education
description: This course provides a structured opportunity for students to engage in a peer-led dialogue on a compelling hot button issue that has important implications for our society. These kinds of topics often elicit strong opinions and have the potential to be divisive. The topic for this dialogue is not predetermined; students who enroll will be sent an electronic survey where they will rank potential dialogue topics based on their interest.
